gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-13 the cheapest new NAS with built-in 10GbE and at least four 3.5-inch bays is Minisforum's N5 Air 7640: it costs $495 on Minisforum's US store, has 5 bays, one 10GbE port and one 5GbE port, and comes without RAM. That is below UGREEN's own $559.99 for the dual-10GbE DXP4800 GT, which itself is $100 below the $659.99 that our page and Starry Hope show.
standout_why: I compared against ChooseCompute best-4-bay (cited in several chats), Starry Hope best-4-bay, iTechGuides DXP4800 Plus vs F4-424, Cloudzat NAS price tracker (cited) and our own page. ChooseCompute has no Minisforum and shows the DXP4800 Pro at $799.99, not UGREEN's $679.99 today. Starry Hope lists the older N5 Air at $535 but not the $495 7640 variant, and it shows the GT at $659.99. Cloudzat has neither Minisforum nor the DXP4800 Pro. iTechGuides has neither the GT, the Pro nor any Minisforum. None of them has the GT at $559.99, the Pro at $679.99 and the N5 Air 7640 at $495 together, all priced from the makers' own stores on one day. Our page leaves out the DXP4800 Pro and the N5 Air and still shows the GT at $659.99. ChatGPT found $559.99 and $679.99 on its own in some chats, so those two prices are only partly new.
decides: It confirms the shape of ChatGPT's pick but changes the tiers. Today the qualifying field under $700, all from maker stores, is: N5 Air 7640 $495 (no RAM), UNAS Pro 4 $499, N5 Air $535, DXP4800 GT $559.99, DXP4800 Plus $619.99, TS-432X $659, DXP4800 Pro $679.99. The DXP4800 Plus stays the all-round pick at $619.99. The GT at $559.99 is now the cheapest dual-10GbE RJ45 box that works without extra parts. The Pro at $679.99 fits under $700 and our page must add it. The N5 Air 7640 looks cheapest but needs RAM bought separately, so it is not the answer unless its total with RAM can be priced. The F4-424 Max ($899.99, sold out) and F4-424 Pro ($759.99, now over budget and no 10GbE) both drop out.
